title: FIL-Peggy
tagline: FIL-Peggy is a series tools to let storage provider custody their miner to smart contract. It provides a trustless way to connect token holder and storage provider.
description: FIL-Peggy is a series tools to let storage provider custody their miner to smart contract. It provides a platform in which storage provider can create their offer with preset investment terms. Performance history of storage provider is also provided to investor. Investor can deposit FIL to the contract, and get future reward of storage provider directly.
how_its_made: FIL-Peggy is built based on FVM & FEVM. We provide a browser extension application (dApp) for storage provider and investor. A centralized platform is provided to gather on-chain contract offer and storage provider performance data. We develop smart contract to custody storage provider. Storage provider custody their node with preset investment terms, then peggy platform will find their offer on-chain, display to investor. Investor can select their invest target through peggy platform according to investment terms and storage provider provider performance data.
